final: WITH driver_totals AS (SELECT driverId, SUM(points) AS driver_total FROM results GROUP BY driverId), overall AS (SELECT SUM(driver_total) AS overall_total FROM driver_totals), paired AS (SELECT d.driver_total, d.driver_total / o.overall_total AS ratio FROM driver_totals d CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.overall_total IS NOT NULL), mean_total AS (SELECT AVG(driver_total) AS average_total FROM paired) SELECT AVG(p.driver_total), AVG(p.ratio), AVG(p.driver_total - m.average_total) FROM paired p CROSS JOIN mean_total m WHERE m.average_total IS NOT NULL AND p.driver_total > m.average_total
